```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 18_regression_calculate_f
title: >
  Calculate F
questions:
  - id: regression_f
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      If $MS_{regression} = 20$ and $MS_{residual} = 4$, what is the F ratio?
    answer: 5
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      $F = MS_{regression} / MS_{residual} = 20 / 4 = 5$.
```
